content: प्रगल्भ {%a.%} .²1 Bold, confident. .²2 Daring, brave, intrepid, spirited, courageous; <ls>Mb. 12. 318. 64</ls>; इति प्रगल्भं पुरुषाधिराजो मृगाधिराजस्य वचो निशम्य <ls>R. 2. 41</ls>. .²3 Bold in speech, eloquent; पुंवत् प्रगल्भा प्रतिहाररक्षी <ls>R. 6. 20</ls>. .²4 Ready-witted, prompt. .²5 Resolute, energetic. .²6 Mature (as age); गुरुः प्रगल्भेऽपि वयस्यतोऽस्यास्तस्थौ निवृत्तान्यवराभिलाषः <ls>Ku. 1. 51</ls>. .²7 Matured, developed, full-grown, strong; प्रगल्भवाक् <ls>Ku. 5. 30</ls> (प्रौढवाक्); <ls>Māl. 9. 29</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 35</ls>. .²8 Skilful; प्रगल्भवनितेव कन्यका प्रणनाम <ls>K. 12</ls>. .²9 Audacious, arrogant, officious, proud. .²10 Shameless, impudent; मुखार्पणेषु प्रकृतिप्रगल्भाः (सिन्धूः) <ls>R. 13. 9</ls>. .²11 Illustrious, eminent. .{@-ल्भा@} .²1 A bold woman. .²2 A shrew, scolding woman. .²3 A bold or mature woman, one of the classes of heroines in poetic composition; she is versed in all kinds of caresses, lofty of demeanour, possessed of no great modesty, of mature age, and ruling her husband; स्मरान्धा गाढतारुण्या समस्तरतकोविदा . भावोन्नता दरव्रीडा प्रगल्भाऽऽकान्तनायका .. <ls>S.
